Messages.Author: Panther
Messages.Body:
This seems really simple, but it's not in the FAQ, and I need to be
sure...

When a combat round is played, and a minion does a press to continue,
do the range setting reset themselves, or, if the previous rounds'
combat was at long range, does the next round of combat also occur
at long range? In other words, if the first round of combat was
moved to long range via a manuever, would the second round stay
at long range?

thanks,
-P.

Also, has a complete list of cards been compiled yet?

Messages.Author: Tor Iver Wilhelmsen
Messages.Body:
Panther <U52368@uicvm.uic.edu> writes:
>This seems really simple, but it's not in the FAQ, and I need to be
>sure...
>
>When a combat round is played, and a minion does a press to continue,
>do the range setting reset themselves, or, if the previous rounds'
>combat was at long range, does the next round of combat also occur
>at long range? In other words, if the first round of combat was
>moved to long range via a manuever, would the second round stay
>at long range?

Well, you do start a new round of combat, and determining range is the
first phase of that. So I would say you begin from assuming close range,
then play maneuvers to change it.

- Tor Iver

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Each round of combat starts at close range.  Maneuvers must be used if
the round is to be done at long range.
